hero.eyebrow: Joe Flores · Selected work before DFB Digital
hero.sub: Twelve years across FMCG, luxury retail, crypto, startups and a security company with very photogenic dogs. Social, content, campaigns, films, and the odd website — the work that came before DFB Digital.

stats: people reached by one startup post

chapters.name: Kinder Bueno
chapters.blurb: Pop culture, hijacked. Game of Thrones, Star Wars and Salt Bae, each bent around a chocolate bar — social content built to be shared, not scrolled past.

chapters.name: TLC Solutions · Taga Linis Co.
chapters.blurb: A cleaning startup built from the ground up: the voice, the campaigns, the app, the website. The Handwash Karaoke post reached 26,105 people with 1,002 engagements — on a startup budget, during lockdown.

chapters.name: Crypto
chapters.blurb: Crypto content for people who don’t read whitepapers: a Star Wars market index, livestream panels, short-form film and memes that landed on the day the market did.

chapters.name: Paul Smith
chapters.blurb: Product stories for a luxury retailer — shot, styled and posted. Shoes, wallets and the books they sit on.

chapters.name: Agro Security Services
chapters.blurb: Content that made a security company likeable: the guards, the dogs, and a reaction poll the whole page voted on.

chapters.name: Chubby Chicken
chapters.blurb: A food brand with a sense of humour, and a 54-second film about getting Chubbyfied.

chapters.name: CVT Community
chapters.blurb: Community content for Casa Verde Townhomes — deliveries, grooming day, and the neighbours as the cast.

chapters.name: Der Armor Philippines
chapters.blurb: Truck bed covers, sold with a stunt and a four-tool GIF.

chapters.name: AICA
chapters.blurb: Academy of International Culinary Arts. “Turning Japanese into your expertise.”

chapters.name: Web
chapters.kicker: Jose Rizal Memorial Foundation · Landing page
chapters.blurb: A landing page for a foundation — clear ask, clear path to give.

chapters.name: The meme desk
chapters.blurb: Memes are a job. Some of them even had clients.

close.p: Now it’s DFB Digital: websites, digital strategy and the systems behind them, with a plain-English reason behind every recommendation.
